Thanks Marissa — great recap. A few clarifications from procurement/security: 

- Procurement path: Acme prefers PO with net-30 for new vendors. We'll need a W9 and the contract (MSA) to start the PO.
- Security: We require SOC 2 Type II (yes) and an executed DPA. We also have a vendor security questionnaire (attached on our side) — happy to have you fill it out or provide a tailored set of answers.
- Timeline: assuming the security docs meet our bar, procurement typically completes in ~2–3 weeks from contract receipt.
- Marketplace: If Redwood is on AWS Marketplace, that can sometimes simplify approvals, but finance still needs contract + W9 for PO issuance.

Can you also send the W9 and confirm who will handle contract redlines (legal or AE)?
